shortDescription: Configures SAN Connectivity Policies on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: description
options.description: A description of the policy. Cisco recommends including information about where and when to use the policy. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the SAN Connectivity Policy. This name can be between 1 and 16 alphanumeric characters. You cannot use spaces or any special characters other than - (hyphen), "_" (underscore), : (colon), and . (period). You cannot change this name after the policy is created.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify SAN Connectivity Policies are present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify SAN Connectivity Policies are absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: vhba_list
options.description: List of vHBAs used by the SAN Connectivity Policy. vHBAs used by the SAN Connectivity Policy must be created from a vHBA template.

options.name: wwnn_pool
options.description: Name of the WWNN pool to use for WWNN assignment.
